container.mistbrn.alembic.idle: Add salt or flakes and matching vials
hud.mistbrn.wheel_hint: Hold V · point · release to choose
message.mistbrn.metal_locked: %s is locked · hold V to change pair
message.mistbrn.milestone.ancient_city: Milestone: the ancient city. Copper and bronze unlocked: their vials now fill your reserve.
message.mistbrn.milestone.bastion: Milestone: the bastion. Tin and pewter unlocked: their vials now fill your reserve.
message.mistbrn.milestone.dragon: Milestone: the dragon. You gained 3 knowledge points for the general tree.
message.mistbrn.milestone.elder_guardian: Milestone: the elder guardian. Zinc and brass unlocked: their vials now fill your reserve.
message.mistbrn.primer.failed: Allomancy: the primer could not be studied; nothing changed.
message.mistbrn.primer.known: Allomancy: you already know iron and steel; the primer was kept.
message.mistbrn.primer.unlocked: Allomancy: you can now burn iron and steel.
message.mistbrn.research.discovered: Discovery: the anchor principle. You gained experience and knowledge.
message.mistbrn.research.evidence: Book: you wrote something new in the diary.
message.mistbrn.research.known: You have already discovered all your notes allow.
message.mistbrn.research.locked: You cannot burn this research's metals yet.
message.mistbrn.research.no_table: Look at an alembic, 5 blocks away at most.
message.mistbrn.research.not_ready: Your notes are not enough for a conclusion yet.
message.mistbrn.research.ready: Book: you can draw a conclusion. Open the book (J) facing an alembic.
message.mistbrn.save_blocked: Allomancy: saved data unreadable; it will not be modified.
message.mistbrn.tutorial.unlocked: Allomancy: the metal burns within you. You can now burn iron (Z) and steel (X).
message.mistbrn.vial.basic_full: Allomancy: no unlocked reserve has room; the vial was not used.
message.mistbrn.vial.failed: Allomancy: the vial could not be drunk; nothing changed.
message.mistbrn.vial.reserve_full: Allomancy: that reserve is full; the vial was not used.
milestone.mistbrn.ancient_city.where: Open an untouched chest in an ancient city, deep under the mountains.
milestone.mistbrn.bastion.where: Enter a bastion remnant in the Nether.
milestone.mistbrn.elder_guardian.where: Help defeat an elder guardian in an ocean monument.
notebook.mistbrn.conclude.refused: Not concluded: face an alembic (5 blocks), in survival.
notebook.mistbrn.help.tree: Wheel or Page Up/Down scrolls; Tab moves, Enter buys.
notebook.mistbrn.hidden.later: Not in this version of the mod yet.
notebook.mistbrn.hints.none: No hints: finding out on your own carries no penalty.
notebook.mistbrn.innate: The pair's own power: yours once the pair is unlocked.
notebook.mistbrn.pair.later: Unlocked · its powers come in a later version
research.mistbrn.anchor_principle.eviden: A loose metal flew to your hand.
A fixed anchor dragged you towards it.
An anchor under your feet lifted you.
research.mistbrn.anchor_principle.hint.1: When you burn iron, who moves: you or the metal? Compare something light with something that cannot move.
research.mistbrn.anchor_principle.hint.2: Pull a loose coin or ingot into your hand; then pull on a fixed iron block.
research.mistbrn.anchor_principle.hint.3: Push with steel on a metal under your feet: if it cannot give way, you rise.
setting.mistbrn.book_scale.tooltip: Size of the book, shrunk if the window is too small.
setting.mistbrn.hud_scale.tooltip: Size of the reserve bars beside the hotbar.
setting.mistbrn.reduce_flashes.tooltip: Warnings and highlights stay lit instead of pulsing.
